lines.text: Welcome to Fairhaven. Please proceed to registration.

lines.text: It is yours. Short bursts, and stay with the line.

lines.text: Military perimeter secured. Stay behind the barriers. They are piling up at the wire!

subtitle.text: Military perimeter secured. Stay behind the barriers. They are piling up at the wire!

lines.text: Alpha at the west wall! It is tearing at the wire!

lines.text: Contact! All sides! Hold the plaza!

lines.text: The west wall is down! They are pouring in! Hold the breach!

lines.text: Alpha at the north wall, by the guns!

lines.text: North wall breached! Hold the gap!

lines.text: They are inside the wire! Line one, fall back to the guns!

lines.text: Alpha at the south wall! Lakeshore side!

subtitle.text: Alpha at the south wall! Lakeshore side!

lines.text: South wall breached! Hold the gap!

subtitle.text: South wall breached! Hold the gap!

lines.text: The guns are down! Back to the trucks, move!

lines.text: Courier! Stay inside the perimeter. Nobody leaves the camp.

subtitle.text: Courier! Stay inside the perimeter. Nobody leaves the camp.

lines.text: The tank has gone quiet. They are all over it!

subtitle.text: The tank has gone quiet. They are all over it!

lines.text: Fall back! Get to the cellar!

subtitle.text: Fall back! Get to the cellar!

lines.text: The cellar under Kessler’s Hardware, far end of Harbor Street! Take Lakeshore, then Metro Road north. Keep moving!
